lines: I had undergone inspection by Kaura, the ultra-sadistic warden, and had sealing piercings put on me.
With the throbbing pain still not having subsided, I had been brought to the cell where I would be living from now on.
A low-ranking troll guard shoved my back.
The heavy metal bars were opened.
Amidahara Prison had cells ranging from A to K, and it was Cell H that I had been led to.
There was no point in disobeying now.
I passed through the metal bars, and set foot in the cell.
Naturally, inside it were the female prisoners who preceded me.
「She's a new one. Take good care of her.」
The guard said, then clanked the metal bars shut, locked them, and departed.
He was saying, “Do as you like after this,” huh?
The female prisoners stared at me scrutinizingly.
Most of them looked to be demons.
They were each passing the time in their own way (lying on the floor, leaning against the wall, etc.), but all of them were silent.
And, they were making the same nasty smile between them.
Somehow, I could predict how things would go beyond this point, yet I still bowed to my senpai prisoners.

「Kuku...... Treat her well, she says......?」
「Sounds good...... Why don't we do that......?」
While saying things like that, the inmates tried to surround me.
This was going increasingly the way I predicted.
Just in case, while making a scared-looking face, I backed away to the wall so that no one could get behind me.
Said a muscular woman who, at a glance, seemed the most capable of them.
「I said, get naked and open yer bag!」
「All your stuff belongs to the Boss o' Cell H.」
The female prisoners were all threatening me.
Of course it turned out like this, huh?
Basically, it was hazing of the new girl by the prisoners.

From the moment I'd heard I would be infiltrating a prison, I had had a feeling there would be something like “The Wringer” or “The Parachute Squad”. (TL: A reference to prison hazing methods in Ashita no Joe.)
But to suddenly be told to get naked... This was a women's prison, all right. I was quite taken by surprise.
If I were the real Kirara-senpai, I would have instantly flown into a rage, and made this place a frozen hell.
「Bitch is so spooked, her voice won't even come out, huh?」
「If you don't strip 'em off yourself, I'll strip 'em for you!」
One of the female inmates reached her hand out to my chest.
To the breasts that even I had been holding back from touching.
I sharply grabbed her wrist, locked the joint, and twisted it.
However, I couldn't afford to have my “toothbrush”, the one possession I had desperately protected, taken away here.
Also, I had heard that if you showed weakness in prison, you would be taken advantage of for the rest of your life.
Plus, I was already on thin ice with the aforementioned piercings, but how angry would Kirara-senpai get if she found out I had showed her naked body to the other inmates?
「I refuse. Both to show you my naked body, and to give you my bag.」
「Looks like you wanna feel the hurt, huh?!」
It appeared that to not be taken lightly by the female prisoners, I would need to make a show of force.
